_doc: THE DECLARED TUNING REGISTER — THE PEN'S FILE.
This file is DECLARED. Its sibling tests/lint/.tuning-inventory.json is MEASURED and is
written by the refreeze ritual alone. Never hand-edit a measured field; never hand-edit
THE VALUES IN THE ESTATE ARE NOT THIS FILE'S TO CHANGE. Every row lands `draft`, and a
row becomes `signed` only through the ritual, driven by a signing record the OWNER wrote
at the tuning sitting. `signatureVersion` is 0 until then. A lane that wants a different
value opens an owner row; it does not edit here.

homes.note: the density ladder (D4). Ten unsuffixed exports the _TUNING glob cannot see.
the half-life ladder. The routing wave owns its thirteen hand-keyed Math.pow sites.
the canonical interval table; two private duplicates are held equal by its role.
a scalar dial imported by name; its consumers read it as a computed leaf.
the F6c roster (post-TAIL-F). Its three _TUNING tables enter by the glob.
D4. INDEXED here, never replaced — the record keeps gating its own dial.

moduleSideCitation: §725.1 — the owner ruled no map leg in launch tuning at all; every map constant is module-side. These ids are enrolled by totality but are REFUSED `signed` and never reach the sitting's desk.

src/domain/worldPulse/faithTuningSurface.note: units read from FAITH_TUNING_COVERAGE; WRATH_SHARPEN_RUNGS counts demotion rungs, so it is a rank rather than a count of things.

units read from FAITH_TUNING_COVERAGE, the F6c roster written as this surface's unit sheet. CAUSAL_SWING is score points per unit channel total and its VALUE lives in faithChannelBindings.js; this table carries the binding by reference.
units read from FAITH_TUNING_COVERAGE: both keys are exposure fractions.

src/domain/worldPulse/npcGrowthKernel.js.note: units read from the table's own per-key comments (ticks, stock points, multipliers, a count cap, an importance fraction and a window in years). Values UNCHANGED and UNSIGNED.

divergence.note: one member holds 0.02 and the rest 0.05. Same name, same role, different value, with nothing in the source saying why. The sitting rules; this lane only records.

three members hold 260 and one holds 312. The charter recorded a fourth value of 24 at 60255ca8e; no member holds it at C-prime, so that spelling is GONE from this role and the divergence is now two-valued, not three.

half_life_ladder.note: the routing wave owns the thirteen hand-keyed Math.pow(0.5, ...) sites; this role indexes the named ladder only, and claims nothing about them.

interval_weeks.note: the canonical interval table. Two private duplicates hold the same values in foodStockpile.js and populationDynamics.js and are HELD EQUAL by this role; folding them by import is car 4, which is optional and the owner's to drop.

exodus_floor__fraction.note: TWO ROLES, not one divergence. The 0.04 member is a fraction of a population; the 300 member is a headcount. One name, two units, two roles - a unit-less field gets a different unit at every consumer, which is why the split is recorded and not argued.

exodus_floor__headcount.note: the headcount half of the EXODUS_FLOOR homonym.

score_max__points.note: the 12-point score ceilings. A third member reads SCORE_MAX as a shorthand aggregator of a module const and is recorded as a computed leaf.

score_max__probability.note: the 0.95 member is a probability ceiling, not a score. Same name, different unit.

divergence.note: an elite-bleed cap of 0.05 and an institution-tolerance cap of 0.5 are two subsystems' ceilings that share a key name. Grouping them by that name was this register's doing, not the estate's, so the divergence is recorded as deliberate rather than handed to the sitting as a disagreement to reconcile. The sitting may overrule this typing; it may not be left untyped.

cap__share.note: the CAP members that bound a share of something.

cap__count.note: the CAP member that bounds a count of things.

divergence.note: an intel-trade cooldown of 26 and a post-succession cooldown of 104 are different clocks that happen to share a key name. Recorded as distinct BY DESIGN so the sitting is not asked to reconcile two things that were never one.

cooldown_weeks.note: the design named this role cooldown_ticks; every measured member is spelled COOLDOWN_WEEKS and carries weeks, so the role takes the measured spelling.

divergence.note: three members hold 0.2, 0.3 and 0.35 across an epidemic, a razing and a route charter. Plausibly deliberate, plausibly drift; nothing in the source says which.

src/domain/relationships/canonicalRelati.cause: T13 Car P-prime replaced a bare computed population bonus with the named constant POPULATION_SATURATION, so this file's +1 unregistered-named is the counterpart of its own -1 bare-decimal win in the same commit. The register is scoring the act it exists to encourage; the name earns its register row when the owner signs the estate, not by a landing.

src/domain/worldPulse/thievesGuild.js.cause: T13 Car P-prime retired an eager det-math call site by placement, and the two literals 0.6 and 0.4 arrived on a single placement-cure line beside the already-registered GUILD_TUNING table. No value was chosen here: they are the constants the retired call site already computed with, relocated rather than authored.
